subject.title: feat(drive): add one-way recursive directory push

question: Should gog own this bounded, non-destructive recursive push workflow as a first-class Drive command?
rationale: The repository has the component primitives, but selecting a reconciliation contract, failure atomicity expectations, and long-term sync surface is a product decision rather than a broken existing-behavior repair.

options.title: Sponsor bounded push
options.body: Approve the proposed one-way, no-delete command subject to plan-before-mutation semantics and live Drive proof.

options.title: Keep primitive-only CLI
options.body: Decline a first-class sync command and document how external scripts can compose listing, folder creation, upload, and replacement primitives.

recommendation.title: Sponsor bounded push
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed one-way, no-delete command subject to plan-before-mutation semantics and live Drive proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice controls whether a new state-reconciliation workflow becomes part of the core Drive CLI contract.
